data.title: Full Stack Open Source Cohort 1 | (Completed)
data.description:
Learn by doing open source contributions

The course is led by Harkirat Singh where we go through an intense 8-10 weeks of learning the MERN stack in depth, and contributing to one big codebase, understanding it in depths and the general ethics when contributing to an open source codebase.

 

Program Description

The program is divided into 4 parts -

  1. Understanding the MERN stack in depth - The first part of the course takes you through the fundamentals and basics of the MERN stack.
  2. Moving from Javascript to Typescript - Making sure you never use JS again in your life, and all your code is written in TS.
  3. Understanding Mono repos - Understanding how real world applications are structured, how code is shared between frontend and backend.
  4. Contributing to open source - Contributing to one real world open source project. This project has raised more than $10 Mn, has a lot of activity on their Github and is a real business. We'll be breaking the project down into smaller subsets and contributing to them independently. Finally we'll be contributing to the main project.

 

Fee breakup

Early bird price of 5999/$75

 

Name of the organiser

Harkirat Singh

 

FAQs

What will be the language of communication

English

What will be the timings of the classes

Live classes will happen on Saturday and Sunday 7PM IST onwards

What if I miss a class

You will get a recording after the class ends, although we strongly suggest you attend the class

How long will the cohort be

The cohort would be 10 weeks but may extend based on the pace of the course

Will I have access to the course after it ends

You will have lifetime access to assignments.

You will have access to the videos for 1 year

When does the course start?

The course starts on 9th of June.

Pre-requisites

To prepare for this course, please watch the video at this link: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=W6NZfCO5SIk . Make sure you understand this video. Functions, objects, variables in Javascript. We will recap this in week 0 but strong suggestion for you to complete this. This is the ONLY pre-requisite.

How many sessions can be logged in at the same time?

You can log in with a maximum of 2 sessions simultaneously.

Will this course only focus on open source contributions or also cover learning the MERN stack?

This course covers both open source contributions and learning the MERN stack.

The MERN stack will be taught from the basics. In lecture 0, we will review JavaScript concepts.
